svg.aria-label: Stack. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL, HTML and CSS. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, React Hook Form, Vite. Backend: Node.js, Express, Server Actions, REST APIs, Zod, Better Auth, JWT. Data: PostgreSQL, SQLite and Turso, Prisma, migrations, triggers. Security: RBAC, session auth, audit logging, rate limiting, CSP. AI and data science: Claude API, Gemini, XGBoost, SHAP, scikit-learn, Sentence-Transformers, Power BI. Testing and delivery: Vitest, Playwright, axe-core, Lighthouse CI, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Render.
